description: Get the Xbox One countdown app from The Microsoft Store, with a real-time countdown to the launch of the new-generation all-in-one gaming and entertainment system as well as games and accessories. Also, get access to news articles, game trailers, and videos about the Xbox One. Xbox One is where the best games, multiplayer, and your favorite movies, music, sports and live TV come together in one place.
